name: cowart-thinking-canvas
description: A source-grounded, non-linear thinking canvas with reversible agent edits and annotation-driven reasoning.

interface.shortDescription: Think with sources, editable visuals, and reversible annotation-driven agent edits.
interface.longDescription: Cowart Thinking Canvas extends the tldraw-powered Cowart workspace with source-aware material cards, compact canvas context, atomic reasoning operations, guarded undo, and a selected-region annotation loop while preserving Cowart's image, HTML, Slides, and project-local storage capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart Thinking Canvas for this project.
Organize these documents into source-linked cards and relationships on the canvas.
Interpret my selected canvas annotations and apply the smallest reversible edit.
Use my Cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Cowart AI image holder.
